steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Tell me, where are the goods? Where are those two wenches?!

steps.speaker: Little Timmy
steps.content: Mmmph... No, no idea... I don't... I don't know anything!!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Ha, both young and old are playin' dumb with me, eh?
Timmy is thrown to the ground. Beside him, a uniformed Wright is gagged and bound, unable to move.
The desert bandit leader viciously kicks Wright's stomach a few times. When he can no longer make any sounds due to the pain, the bandit draws a knife and hands it to his underling.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: If you're not gonna talk, I'll make sure you never speak again.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: You, in the uniform, open your eyes wide and watch how I tear this kid apart...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Don't gag him, let him scream! The louder the better. I'm sure they won't ignore his cries... Ah!
The desert bandit leader was interrupted by a metal bucket thrown at the back of his head.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Let 'em go! The invincible Hella's right here!
